output.summary: The evidence does not support the COO's pay diagnosis or the manager-blame proposal. Separations were already elevated (about 11/month against 7.2) before the HRIS migration. They stepped up in March 2026, right after the all-branch Saturday policy took effect on March 2, and then held flat at about 17/month. ShiftWise went live April 13, and April shows no further step. Pay is cited at the same rate in both years (61% vs 58%), and the market position is unknown because the last study was in 2023. Exit-survey response rates are low (19%) and the manager option was added only in 2026. I would not approve the irreversible 15% raise or the bonus withholding now. Instead, get the branch-level data and a current pay benchmark. A targeted adjustment can still be made through the January cycle.
